## Changes

- Add `AssetRegistry` export (#2885) and `react-native-web/asset-registry` entry point (#2886)
- Share `AssetRegistry` between CJS and ESM builds (#2887)
- Remove deprecation warnings for APIs that React Native does not deprecate (#2892)

## New contributors

- @zoontek made their first contribution in #2865
- @byCedric made their first contribution in #2885

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/necolas/react-native-web/compare/0.21.3...0.21.4

## What's Changed

- `Image`: new `onLoad`, `onLoadStart`, `onLoadEnd` or `onError` callbacks (e.g. inline functions) no longer abort and restart the image load. Fixes #2850. By @AbdullahAnsarii in https://github.com/necolas/react-native-web/pull/2851
- `useColorScheme`: the hook now subscribes once per component instead of on every render. Fixes #2848. By @huytdps13400 in https://github.com/necolas/react-native-web/pull/2853
- `InputAccessoryView` is now exported from the package entry. Fixes #2806.

## New Contributors

- @huytdps13400 made their first contribution in https://github.com/necolas/react-native-web/pull/2856
- @AbdullahAnsarii made their first contribution in https://github.com/necolas/react-native-web/pull/2851

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/necolas/react-native-web/compare/0.21.2...0.21.3
